description:
Outcome: Gardener sees own application, waitlist position, allocated plot and dates, from brief.md / First version 3 and Constraints.
Scope: Own household status and allocation view. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Accurate after allocation/release; another household's data/contact details inaccessible.
Behaviour: Accessible pending/empty/loading/error/retry states. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Authorization/status tests and phone walkthrough of every state. Prerequisites: T-005, T-006, T-007. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Show gardener status, allocation and season
